第24章 小舅子变形记-《重生80，分家后带妻女吃香喝辣》

赵志军来店里的那天，是周一。

早上五点，天还没亮透，他就骑着自行车从赵家洼赶到了镇上。

穿着一件半新的蓝色工装。

是他爹专门给他找出来的，说是“干活就得有个干活的样子”。

头发也没抹发胶，清清爽爽的，看着比平时顺眼不少。

但一进门，那股子公子哥的劲儿还是没褪干净。

他站在店门口，往里探了探头，鼻子先皱了一下。

灶台上冒着热气，卤肉的香味混着油烟味，呛得他咳了两声。

“三姐夫，这也太呛了吧？”

林国强正在灶台前和面，头也没抬：“习惯了就好。

进来，把门关上，别让热气跑了。”

赵志军磨磨蹭蹭地走进来，东看看西摸摸，像一只进了陌生地盘的小公鸡。

赵素梅在后面的小隔间里安顿两个孩子。

林静还在睡，林薇醒了，坐在小床上玩布老虎。

“志军来了？”赵素梅探出头来，“吃了没？”

“没呢，三姐，起太早了，顾不上。”

“等着，我给你盛碗粥。”

赵素梅从锅里舀了一碗玉米面粥，又拿了一个肉夹馍，递给他。

赵志军接过来，咬了一口肉夹馍，眼睛立刻亮了。

“三姐夫，你这肉夹馍也太好吃了吧？”

“好吃就多吃点，吃饱了干活。”

林国强终于抬起头，看了他一眼，“今天先学洗菜、切菜。”

“洗菜切菜？”赵志军嘴里塞着馍，含糊不清地说，“那也太简单了吧？”

“简单？”林国强笑了笑，“那你先试试。”

赵志军吃完早饭，撸起袖子，走到水池边。

水池里堆着一大盆青菜。

小白菜、菠菜、香菜，都是赵素梅早上从菜市场买的，还带着露水。

他把菜倒进水池里，拧开水龙头，哗啦啦地冲。

冲了两下，就捞出来放在案板上，拿起菜刀。

“等等。”林国强走过来，拿起一根菠菜，指着根部的泥土，“看见没？这上面还有泥。

洗菜不是冲一下就行，得一片一片地掰开，把泥洗干净。

The day Zhao Zhijun came to the store was Monday.

At five o'clock in the morning, before dawn, he rode his bicycle from Zhaojiawa to the town.

Wearing a new blue overalls.

His father found it specially for him, saying, "To work, you have to look like you are working."

There is no hairspray on my hair, it feels fresh and refreshing, and it looks much more pleasing to the eye than usual.

But as soon as I walked in, the young master's spirit still hadn't faded away.

He stood at the door of the store, poked his head in, and wrinkled his nose.

Steam was rising from the stove, and the aroma of braised pork mixed with the smell of oil smoke made him cough twice.

"Third brother-in-law, isn't this too choking?"

Lin Guoqiang was kneading noodles in front of the stove without raising his head: "Just get used to it.

Come in, close the door, don't let the heat escape."

Zhao Zhijun walked in slowly, looking here and there, like a little rooster entering a strange territory.

Zhao Sumei settled her two children in the small cubicle at the back.

Lin Jing was still sleeping, and Lin Wei woke up, sitting on the small bed and playing with cloth tiger.

"Zhijun is here?" Zhao Sumei poked her head out, "Have you eaten?"

"No, third sister, I got up too early to care."

"Wait, I'll serve you a bowl of porridge."

Zhao Sumei scooped out a bowl of cornmeal porridge from the pot, then took a meat bun and handed it to him.

Zhao Zhijun took it and took a bite of the meat bun, and his eyes immediately lit up.

"Third brother-in-law, isn't your Roujiamo delicious?"

"Eat more if it tastes good, and work when you're full."

Lin Guoqiang finally raised his head and glanced at him, "Today I will learn to wash and cut vegetables."

"Wash and chop vegetables?" Zhao Zhijun said vaguely with a bun in his mouth, "Isn't that too simple?"

"Easy?" Lin Guoqiang smiled, "Then you try it first."

After Zhao Zhijun finished breakfast, he rolled up his sleeves and walked to the pool.

There is a large pot of vegetables piled in the pool.

Chinese cabbage, spinach, and coriander were all bought by Zhao Sumei from the vegetable market in the morning, and they were still wet with dew.

He poured the vegetables into the sink, turned on the faucet, and rinsed.

After rinsing twice, I took it out and put it on the chopping board, then picked up the kitchen knife.

"Wait a minute." Lin Guoqiang came over, picked up a spinach, and pointed at the soil at the root, "Did you see it? There's still mud on it.

Washing vegetables is not just about rinsing them, you have to break them apart one by one and wash away the mud.
